in_marathi.name: Aseem
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Not far, near
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aseem हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Aseem is derived from Sanskrit and means 'not far' or 'near'. It is a name rooted in Hindu mythology, referring to the god Indra who is believed to be close to his devotees.
